user_goal.ko: 놓친 사고 표본 계획이 있는 변경 전후 검토
user_goal.en: a before-after review with a missed-incident sampling plan

task.expected_artifact: a before-after review with a missed-incident sampling plan

messages.content:
다음 개선 전에 근거를 감사해줘: 알림 임계값 검토
맥락: 임계값은 지난달 변경됐고 알림량이 줄었지만 놓친 사고 샘플 검토는 없다.
산출물: 놓친 사고 표본 계획이 있는 변경 전후 검토
놓친 사례를 확인하지 않고 알림 감소를 건강 개선으로 해석하지 않는다.
쓸 수 있는 다음 단계는 알림 임계값 검토. 끊겼던 작업을 여기서 계속하자. 메모 내용은 이래: 임계값은 지난달 변경됐고 알림량이 줄었지만 놓친 사고 샘플 검토는 없어. 원하는 결과는 놓친 사고 표본 계획이 있는 변경 전후 검토. 앞선 범위도 봐줘.
다음 단계가 뻔해 보여도 빈칸을 채우지 말아줘.

Audit the evidence before improving an alert-threshold review. Context: The threshold was changed last month, alert volume dropped, and there is no sampled review of missed incidents. Deliver: a before-after review with a missed-incident sampling plan. Do not interpret fewer alerts as improved health without checking misses.

I want a usable next step for an alert-threshold review. Picking this up: the threshold was changed last month, alert volume dropped, and there is no sampled review of missed incidents. A before-after review with a missed-incident sampling plan could look like this. For an alert-threshold review, keep old limits visible.
Do not fill a blank just because the next step feels obvious.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for an alert-threshold review.
Do not interpret fewer alerts as improved health without checking misses.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about an alert-threshold review.
Do not interpret fewer alerts as improved health without checking misses.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
